securityContract.attackerControlledInput: Authenticated multipart photo uploads sent to the workpack improvement route and dedicated photo-analysis route.
securityContract.vulnerableBehavior: The improvement route parsed multipart files and reached vision analysis without request, file-count, aggregate-byte, MIME-signature, or shared admission controls.
securityContract.enforcementBoundary: Declared request bytes are checked before multipart parsing; parsed files are counted, summed, and signature-validated before provider or persistence work.
securityContract.preservedBehavior: Bounded Before/After improvement photos and bounded dedicated hazard photos remain available.
